items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring. Previously doubtful after limited Friday practice.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; BAL WR room crumbs.
items.opportunity: Targets to Mark Andrews, Isaiah Likely, remaining WRs.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers doubtful for Sunday; elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White from practice squad.
items.why: Knee; limited Friday, will test pregame but rare to play through doubtful.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer and elevated Myarick for snaps/routes.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs Patriots with foot injury.
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf and other PIT WRs see target bump.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Sunday vs Bengals after missing practices.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining HOU pass-catchers including TE Dalton Schultz.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (ribs) questionable after DNP-DNP-Limited; biggest injury on slate per Levitan, impacts Herbert projections; 4pm ET game.
items.why: Ribs from Week 1; limited Friday return.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Quentin Johnston and others gain targets/routes.

items.text: Rams listed WR Puka Nacua questionable for MNF vs Giants (hip/groin soreness after Thursday practice); will not practice Saturday; Whittington doubtful (quad). Likely pregame decision.
items.why: Groin soreness post-Thursday practice; different from camp psoas; McVay notes not full speed.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; monitor inactives.
items.opportunity: If OUT, TE Ferguson/Parkinson and other WRs (Adams healthy) gain routes/targets.

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow questionable (back) but expected/good to go vs Texans; Burrow said he's playing.
items.why: Back; full practice indicators and coach comments; elevation is precaution.

items.text: Alvin Kamara expected back (IN); Berry notes Etienne Week 1 reduced workload concerning, especially with Kamara return squeezing passing-game role further as underdogs.
items.opportunity: Kamara reclaims third-down/passing; Etienne early-down committee with Miller possible.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) IN for 2026 debut vs Steelers; Levitan notes Pats desperately need playmakers—do they give him 10+ touches vs Stevenson?
items.why: Full practices; off injury report; ready to go.
items.implication: Flex upside in timeshare; monitor snap share.
items.opportunity: 10+ touch potential; explosive role expansion in NE backfield needing playmakers.

items.text: Levitan: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; affects so many projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET. BAL/HOU/NE down to WR crumbs.
items.implication: Hedge Herbert/McConkey stacks; pivot if OUT.
items.opportunity: Monitor for role expansion to QJ/Njoku if inactive.

items.text: Berry LOVES Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (tied team lead), 24% target share Week 1. Indy allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage/util + soft run matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; RB1 overall range possible if healthy.

items.text: Berry LOVES Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: Week 1 Utilization Score 99 (tied Bijan lead); 19% target share last 10 games; 25+ touches in 3/4 recent.
items.why: Elite util under Kubiak; overreaction to injury scare.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving (26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell) vs CLE and Justin Jefferson (37% tgt share from Wentz, strong history) @ CHI.
items.why: Irving elite util/RZ; Jefferson Wentz volume + matchup.
items.implication: Strong starts; Irving RB9+ util play.
items.opportunity: Irving passing + RZ monopoly; Jefferson high aDOT/share.

items.text: Berry HATES Travis Etienne (matched Miller rushes Week 1, air-dependent; Kamara return squeezes) and Marvin Harrison Jr. (8% tgt share Week 1, 0 RZ, tough SEA matchup).
items.why: Etienne committee squeeze; MHJ low share + tough defense.
items.opportunity: Negative for Etienne role; MHJ needs share expansion.
